entries.rationale: Treat impressions without clicks as indexing and demand evidence, not a successful outcome. Use the August 1 black-clad-character page as the visual benchmark for the current AI Game Master comparison, with a newly generated original dark-fantasy campaign keeper rather than recognizable or licensed D&D characters or art. Keep future content and publication human-guided; the unattended Codex publishing schedules and repository cron/recovery entry points remain removed.

Implement the three explicitly proposed click-improvement changes on the current comparison page: a shorter query-led title and specific snippet, a crawlable semantic original hero image with image metadata, and a descriptive homepage link. Keep the change local and reviewed; this approval does not authorize automatic deployment.
